meta.interpretation: The user wants to know whether larger Phase 3 diabetes trials also run longer. I plot one point per trial — enrollment against trial duration in months — for interventional Phase 3 diabetes trials, so any relationship (or lack of one) is visible.
assumptions: Restricted to trials starting in 2010 or later; the user gave no date window.
'Diabetes' is passed as the user wrote it, so API synonym/MeSH expansion includes type 1, type 2 and diabetes complications (e.g. diabetic retinopathy, diabetic foot).
Only interventional trials are included, since observational studies carry no phase.
Duration is start-to-completion and is approximate where only year-level dates are reported; trials missing enrollment or either date cannot be plotted.
Enrollment mixes actual and estimated counts, as sponsors reported them.
Points are coloured by recruitment status, since terminated or withdrawn trials tend to be short for reasons unrelated to planned size.
warnings: The initial plan failed schema validation and was corrected after 1 attempt(s).
22 trials were omitted because they did not report both enrollment and duration_months.
